topic.title: Neural Differential Equations and Solver-Aware Learning
topic.area: Continuous Models and Scientific Machine Learning
topic.overview: Neural differential equations describe learned transformations as continuous dynamics rather than only a fixed sequence of layers. This topic connects model design with numerical integration, regularization, and hybrid physical solvers. Training must account for how difficult the learned dynamics are to solve, not merely how accurately they fit observations.
topic.whyItMatters: A flexible dynamical model can become computationally expensive or numerically unstable as learning proceeds. Solver-aware objectives expose a useful trade-off between predictive performance and integration cost, while structured hybrid architectures can incorporate known problem structure rather than leaving every operation to a black box.
topic.evolution: A 1990 representative derives optimizing dynamics from a Lagrangian formulation. Neural ODE work appears prominently in 2018, followed by regularization of trajectories, Jacobians, and solver behavior. A 2020 method penalizes a differentiable surrogate of solving time; 2026 work links operator-splitting schemes with unrolled hybrid architectures for fluid simulations.
openQuestions: How can training objectives predict solver cost outside the training trajectories?
Which numerical structures should be preserved when replacing solver components with learned modules?

papers.title: Learning Manifold and Itô Dynamics with Branched Neural Rough Differential Equations
papers.tldr: B-NRDEs adapt rough differential equation models to Itô calculus and manifold geometry while preserving manifold constraints.

papers.title: Neuro-Symbolic AI for Analytical Solutions of Differential Equations
papers.tldr: SIGS combines grammar-constrained symbolic expressions with continuous optimization to discover PDE solutions and accurate symbolic approximations without solution data.

papers.title: NeurOCNN: A Neural-Operator-Based Model for Physiological Time Series
papers.tldr: NeurOCNN combines continuous-time convolutions and Fourier pooling to classify physiological signals robustly across previously unseen sampling rates.

papers.title: Proximal Splitting Methods for Hybrid Differentiable Models
papers.tldr: The paper derives hybrid learning architectures from operator splitting schemes and reports improved fluid-simulation accuracy and stability.

papers.title: Stabilizing Equation Learning via Zero-Point Constraints
papers.tldr: EQL-Z combines zero-point-consistent operators and gradual structure search to recover simpler equations more reliably.

papers.title: Understanding Dynamics of Adam in Zero-Sum Games: An ODE Approach
papers.tldr: An ODE analysis of Adam-DA finds momentum effects opposite to those in minimization, with supporting experiments in adversarial network training.
